page.seo_title: Private Food Tours Malaysia | Simply Enak
page.seo_description: Book a private food tour in Malaysia with Simply Enak. Your group only, your pace, your guide.
page.hero_subtitle: Your group, your pace, your guide — from just two people to a corporate team.
page.why_subtitle: You book the guide. You get the guide. No strangers, no compromises.
page.configurator_body: Tell us who you are and what matters — we'll sketch a route and refine it on WhatsApp.
page.pricing_heading: Pricing depends on group size and tour
page.pricing_body: Contact us with your dates and group size — we'll send you a quote within a few hours. Groups of 6 or more typically see lower per-person rates.
page.available_privately_subtext: Choose the tour that fits your group, then tell us you'd like it private.
page.corporate_callout: For corporate groups: We also take work groups and corporate visitors to the stalls locals eat at.
